heard: NASA caught a star swallowing a Jupiter-sized planet. Everyone assumed an aging star expanded and ate its neighbor. Infrared surveys first spotted the flash across our galaxy. Astronomers expected to find a swollen red giant. NASA appointed the James Webb Space Telescope at the star. Spectra proved the host star had not swollen up. Gravitational drag caused the planet's orbit to slowly decay. The planet plunged to its death into an unexpanded star. Webb even detected carbon monoxide gas from the wreckage. It proved how a world spirals directly into its sun.
